shortDescription: A supported machine squat that follows an arcing path, targeting the quadriceps with assistance from the glutes and adductors.
instructions: Adjust the machine's starting position and safety stops, then position your back against the support and your shoulders beneath the pads.
Place both feet securely on the platform in a comfortable stance and hold the handles.
Extend your legs enough to release the safety catch, keeping your knees softly extended.
Bend your knees and hips to lower the machine under control. Keep your heels on the platform and your back against the support, using a comfortable range of motion.
Push through your feet to return to the starting position without bouncing or forcefully locking your knees.
After the final repetition, engage the safety catch before stepping out of the machine.
notes: Follow the setup and safety instructions for your machine. Muscle factors are app defaults. Log added plate weight consistently; resistance varies between machine designs.
